notes: 1.3.39: Pixabay is asked by category (nature, then animals) for every subject that is not about people, so its kitchens, sports, people, food and transport never reach the picture judge; a subject about people is asked without a category. Pexels has no such filter. Also in this line: the picture judge (1.3.34), an update keeping your settings (1.3.35), the judge beside the engine when the card has room and on the processor otherwise (1.3.38).
